# SOP-P1-L4-03 First-article inspection - Heat Treat line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-CN01, EQ-P1-L4-HP02, EQ-P1-L4-HT03  
Related: ECN-2026-002, ECN-2026-007, SB-1012

1. Preconditions
   1. Verify first-article authorization is present and matches part drawing referenced in ECN-2026-002.
   2. Ensure EQ-P1-L4-CN01, EQ-P1-L4-HP02 and EQ-P1-L4-HT03 are in serviceable condition per SB-1012.

2. PPE
   1. Select PPE per plant policy in ECN-2026-007.
   2. Required items must be donned before entering the equipment work envelope.

3. Setup verification
   1. Confirm workholding and tooling are the configuration approved for first-article.
   2. Confirm the chuck jaw bolt torque for Heat Treat CNC turning center #1 (EQ-P1-L4-CN01) is 90 N·m.
   3. Confirm hydraulic system reservoir contains lubricant part number CFW-LUB-195 for EQ-P1-L4-HP02.

4. Inspection sequence
   1. Load first-article with approved fixtures.
   2. Execute programmed cycle for first-article using the approved program revision.
   3. Capture dimensional data as specified on first-article checklist and compare to drawing tolerances.

5. Nonconformance handling
   1. If any dimension fails, stop production and record findings on the first-article report.
   2. Notify Engineering and reference ECN-2026-007 for disposition routes.

6. Documentation
   1. Complete the first-article inspection form and attach measurement records.
   2. Archive forms according to SB-1012 retention rules.

7. Sign-off
   1. Inspector name:
   2. Inspector signature:
   3. Date:
   4. Quality approval name:
   5. Quality approval signature:
   6. Date:

Notes: All actions must reference ECN-2026-002, ECN-2026-007 and SB-1012 where procedural or disposition guidance is required.
